assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and lightheadedness that have persisted despite medical management for known sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has a known sick sinus syndrome.
The symptoms warrant evaluation for arrhythmic activity.
A mobile cardiac telemetry study is ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
The study is ordered to evaluate the correlation between symptomatic events and potential arrhythmic activity.
The service is documented in the clinical indication note.
The CPT code for the mobile cardiac telemetry study is 93229.
The diagnosis code I49.5 supports the medical necessity of this service.
The diagnosis code R42 supports the medical necessity of this service.
